Hi Soojin / Marissa —

Trying to complete the vendor registration in Coupa but I keep hitting an error during the final step: “Credentials mismatch / duplicate entity detected.” I filled the form with our legal name and EIN but the portal won’t let me proceed. Screenshot attached.

Hi Emily —

Thanks for the quick note and for attaching the W-9. Sorry you hit that error — makes sense to get this unblocked now so PO routing can be set up. Quick checklist to help us triage:

- Confirm the company legal name exactly as shown on the W-9 (case-sensitive spacing/punctuation).
- Provide the EIN with no dashes (e.g., 123456789). Coupa often requires numeric-only.
- If you registered with a generic email (accounts-payable@...), try registering with a person-specific address (emily.shaw@...) for the initial invite. We can change the AP routing after account verification.

I’m attaching our vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf — please fill the highlighted fields (legal name, EIN, billing address, remittance details) and reply. If the portal is still rejecting the submission, I’ll open a ticket with Coupa and request a temporary invite link.

Plan: once we confirm the entity mapping, I’ll ask Procurement to enable PO routing and set default GL code mappings. Aditya / Marissa — please standby to expedite verification when Emily returns the checklist.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Senior Procurement Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0123

From: Coupa Portal Support <portal-support@coupa.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Emily Shaw <emily.shaw@greenridge.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Trouble creating Coupa vendor account (GreenRidge)

Hi all —

Thanks for reaching out. We reviewed GreenRidge’s recent registration attempts. The portal flagged a potential duplicate because the tax ID on the submission included a dash and the existing mapping in our master vendor index is stored without punctuation. To resolve:

- Please re-submit the EIN using digits only (no dash). Example: 123456789.
- Ensure the legal name exactly matches the W-9; abbreviations (Co. vs Company) can trigger duplicate checks.
- If you prefer, we can generate a one-time registration link that bypasses the duplicate check so a live agent can validate and merge records.

Temporary link (valid 48 hours): https://coupa.com/temp-invite/4f3b9a (attached as coupa_temp_invite_link.txt)

If you want us to proceed with the merge, respond with the canonical legal name and the numeric EIN and we’ll route to our vendor data team.

Best,
Coupa Portal Support
support-team@coupa.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Emily —

Thanks — please try the temporary invite link from Coupa and re-submit the registration using the EIN without punctuation. I’ve also attached a fillable copy of our onboarding checklist to make the required fields explicit (vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf). When you’ve completed it, reply to this thread and I’ll personally confirm the mapping with Procurement.

Internal note to Aditya / Marissa: once GreenRidge confirms the checklist and Coupa verifies the entity, please do the following so we can start sending POs:
- Approve vendor in Redwood’s procurement console and set PO routing to accounts-payable@greenridge.com.
- Set default payment terms to Net 30 and the initial GL code to 5001 until finance confirms mapping.
- Flag for expedited onboarding in Coupa (ticket #RG-041-expedite).

Emily — if you prefer, I can jump on a quick 20-minute call to walk through the submission.

Thanks,
